rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a postal mailbox or receptacle.

example.english: I put the letter in the mailbox.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 fung1 seon3 fong3 jap6 jau4 soeng1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a public street postbox where people drop off mail.

example.english: I went to the mailbox at the street corner to mail a postcard.
example.traditional: 我去街口個郵筒寄張明信片。
example.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 gaai1 hau2 go3 jau4 tung4 gei3 zoeng1 ming4 seon3 pin2

rows.note: Use this for an electronic inbox where email is received and stored.

example.english: Check your mailbox to see if there are any new emails.
example.traditional: 你睇下收件箱，有冇新電郵？
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 haa5 sau1 gin6 soeng1 jau5 mou5 san1 din6 jau4
